Root cause: claytonlib's SafariContext.__adjusted_catch_rate_b divided by 2 where the game divides by 3. Per pokeheartgold battle_command.c (GetShakeCount, Safari Ball path): ballMultiplier = sStandardBallCatchRates[SAFARI_BALL-2] = 15 (x1.5), then modifiedCatchRate = ((catchRate*15)/10)/3 -- the /3 is the full-HP lostHp/maxHpTimes3 = (3M-2M)/(3M) factor. claytonlib had species_mod*1.5/2 (the 1.5 ballMultiplier was right, the /2 HP factor was wrong; should be /3). This over-eased captures at high capture-rate stages (after heavy mud), predicting 'C' where the emulator broke free (stage+4: game b=23301 vs claytonlib 26214; roll 23646 >= 23301 -> break). Fix: /2 -> /3 (one char). Verified: validate_safari 10/10 records; all 32 balls across records consistent; full suite 541 green; KNOWN_DIVERGENCES cleared.
